claims: NASA's Artemis program aims to return humans to the Moon, including the first woman and person of color.
NASA's Artemis program aims to establish a sustainable presence on the Moon.
NASA's Artemis program aims to prepare for Mars.
Artemis II is currently in flight in April 2026.
Artemis II is a 10-day crewed lunar flyby.
Artemis III is planned to land astronauts at the South Pole.
